title: The Hebrew Bible as compressed historical record
statement: The framework's global reading posture toward the Hebrew Bible: the Tanakh is read not as religious myth but as a compressed, transmitted, and theologically reworked historical record of the creators' engagement — a posture that licenses the corpus's passage-level readings while binding them to the transmission disciplines the record carries (composition history, redaction, translation loss, and the memory sciences' loss characteristics all conceded at full strength); the posture is the framework's, and every specific reading still stands or falls on its own record.

includes: The posture: historical record beneath theological reworking — the reading stance every framework claim about biblical passages instantiates

The bound disciplines, conceded in full: documentary composition history, redactional theology, the Masoretic transmission's own history, translation loss (the singular-God rendering of woh-claim-0009 as the exhibit), and the compression-and-loss results the 0004 apparatus records
The distribution rule: this record licenses no specific reading; each passage-level claim has or needs its own record, and this posture cannot be cited as evidence for any of them
excludes: Inerrancy in either direction; a record can be historical and corrupted, theological and preservative
Uniform historicity across genres; psalms, law, wisdom, and narrative carry memory differently and per-genre work is editorial
The New Testament and other corpora, which need their own posture records if the corpus develops them
Any claim that mainstream scholarship shares the posture; it does not, and the record says so

source_references.locator: The canon's global stance toward the biblical text as trace of real events, stated across the decoded readings
The critical-scholarly frame the posture concedes and works within
The transmission-history discipline (Masoretic tradition, variants) the posture binds itself to

alternatives.statement: The Hebrew Bible's genres are theology, liturgy, law, and identity narrative; 'historical record beneath' is a category the corpus brings, not one the text supports.
A global posture record risks laundering support to passage readings by ambient framing even while formally licensing none.

revision_triggers: Claim woh-claim-0001 is revised or retired.
Any artifact cites this record as evidence for a specific reading — the posture-laundering failure this record names as its own hazard.
The bound disciplines are weakened in derived prose.
